newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Sept 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Malaysian is sentenced to life imprisonment after he was arrested for possession of 95 kilos of shabu, or ice, with a street value of 200 million pesos (MANILA STANDARD)
- Police suspect the vigilante group Mindanao Chistian Unified Command may be behind a grenade explosion at the Zamboanga city hall on Friday (TODAY)
- The Armed Forces of the Philippines has set in motion an action plan to neutralise through peaceful means more than 30 vigilante groups in Mindanao (STAR)
- The Metro Manila Development Authority says more than 7,500 big commercial, government establishments and individuals have been apprehended in its anti-littering campaign (MANILA BULLETIN)
- Minority bloc in the Senate say they will vehemently oppose the lifting of bank secrecy law as part of the comprehensive tax reform package (BUSINESS DAILY)
- The International Monetary Fund wants loans to real estate projects to be monitored to determine their impact on the economy
- The Department of Finance will soon exempt foreign investors in government securities from paying the required 20 percent withholding tax to foreigners (STAR)
